meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 AnnData 格式读取、写入和操作带注释的数据矩阵,支持 .h5ad、.zarr 等文件:创建对象、按条件筛选、合并数据集、转置、查看维度等。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 .h5ad 或 .zarr 文件,比如读取、写入、合并或筛选单细胞表达矩阵时,或需要与 scanpy 等 scverse 生态工具衔接时触发。

say.text: 读取 data.h5ad,显示观测数和基因数
把 batch1 和 batch2 的 h5ad 按行合并,加批次标签
say.note: 用 ad.concat 合并并标记批次

say.text: 将 data.h5ad 转成 zarr 并启用压缩
say.note: 调用 write_zarr 完成转换

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the AnnData Python package to read, write, and manipulate annotated data matrices — creating objects from .h5ad/.zarr, subsetting by conditions, concatenating batches, transposing, and inspecting dimensions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to work with .h5ad or .zarr files, such as reading, writing, merging, or filtering single-cell expression matrices, or when integrating with scverse ecosystem tools like scanpy.

say_en.text: Read data.h5ad and show the numbers of observations and variables
Concatenate batch1.h5ad and batch2.h5ad along rows with a batch label
Convert data.h5ad to zarr with compression enabled
